messages:
maya: Quick heads-up: Felix put in notice, last day 2026-12-15. He's relocating internationally and asked about COBRA, final pay, and access cutover. Can we split owners?

tomo: I can take cloud and SSO workflows. Need a list of org-admin roles and any personal deploy keys.

felix: Laptop SN RW-SEA-7711. I have one GitHub deploy key, two personal SSH keys, and an API token for the metrics platform. Happy to add backups to projects this week.

maya: Draft actions: 
• create offboard ticket and attach inventory (People Ops)
• schedule exit interview and confirm final paycheck date (People Ops)
• vendor benefits stop date + COBRA packet timing (People Ops)
• disable SSO on last day, keep email available 24h (Tomo)
• revoke personal keys and PATs on last day (Tomo)
• rotate vault and shared tokens; document rotations (IT)
• collect device and confirm MDM unenroll (Felix + IT)

tomo: For keys/tokens, I'll run a sweep and post results: `gh api /user/keys` and `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --filter="user:felix@redwood.com"`. Will add any SA keys to the ticket.

felix: Note - I'm a sole admin on one Grafana org. I can add two team admins by EOD. Also, I have a personal PAT used in a CI pipeline; will remove prior to last day but please revoke org tokens at cutover.

it-bot: Ticket created: HR-9401 "Felix offboard - international relocation, device, access". Assigned to Tomo. SLA: initial triage 2 business days.

maya: COBRA/benefits: since Felix is US-based until 12/15, benefits coverage runs through 2026-12-31 (EOM). We'll send a COBRA-plus-relocation info packet 2026-12-16 with vendor link and who to contact for questions. If he moves abroad, payroll will coordinate tax/withholding implications.

it-bot: Note: please include proof of device return (photo of serial) and MDM unenroll log in ticket to close.

tomo: Proposed last-day schedule: 08:30 disable SSO (email access until 09:00), 09:00 revoke PATs/keys, 09:30 remove from oncall/alerting groups, 10:00 rotate shared secrets and update runbook.

maya: Felix, please confirm drop-off method (will you ship or drop at office?) and whether you need a prepaid label. Also confirm if you want HR to delay COBRA packet delivery until you have relocation address.

felix: I'll ship the laptop from my last location; prefer a prepaid label. You can send COBRA packet to my US address 12/16; I'll discuss relocation tax with payroll later. I'll schedule a 30-min handoff next week. Thanks for making the process smooth.

it-bot: HR-9401 updated: shipping label requested, Grafana admin transfer noted, added vault rotation checklist.

maya: Two final asks: 1) check any outstanding contractor invoices tied to Felix's projects and 2) comp team - confirm equity vesting alignment. I'll loop in payroll and comp after inventory is complete.

felix: I'll upload outstanding invoice receipts to the ticket and confirm equity Qs in the exit interview.

people-bot: Exit interview invite sent for 2026-12-09 10:00. Please add any items you want on the agenda to HR-9401.
